description: This PHP source file is part of the TestLink project and handles the export of custom fields to an XML file. It initializes parameters, handles export actions, interacts with the database to retrieve custom field data, and outputs the data as an XML document for download.

classes.name: ADODB_XML
classes.description: Class for converting database query results into XML format.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Template engine class used for rendering the output page.

methods.name: doExport
methods.description: Performs the export of custom fields from the database into an XML file and initiates download.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request arguments for the export process.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies if the user has permission to view custom fields.
